exercises.name: Stick elevation (active-assisted forward elevation)
exercises.side_question: Which arm is the injured one?
exercises.side_meaning: the injured arm (both hands hold the stick)
exercises.camera: from the front, upper body and arms in view (from the knees up)
instructions: Stand facing the phone, holding a stick with both hands, arms straight down.
Lift the stick forward and up with straight elbows, then lower it all the way down.

exercises.name: Arm abduction
exercises.camera: from the front, upper body and arms in view (from the knees up)
instructions: Stand facing the phone, arms by your sides.
Lift the arm sideways with a straight elbow, without shrugging or leaning, then lower it to your side.

exercises.name: Arm rotation (elbow at the side)
exercises.camera: from the front, upper body and arms in view (from the knees up)
instructions: Stand facing the phone, elbow bent at 90 degrees and against your side.
Rotate the forearm outward and back, keeping the elbow against your body.

exercises.name: Standing hip abduction (chair support)
exercises.side_meaning: the lifted leg (stand on the other leg, holding the chair)
exercises.camera: from the FRONT, the WHOLE body in view including both feet (unlike e1-e3: the ankles are the main points), phone upright at hip height about 2-3 m away; the chair beside the standing leg, the patient holding it; image NOT mirrored (un-mirror the selfie preview before MediaPipe), upright (rotate by the sensor orientation)
exercises.range_target: the physiotherapist can set a target angle per patient (degrees); see app_spec_e4.json range
instructions: Stand facing the phone, with a chair beside you; hold it with the hand on the side of the leg you stand on. Your whole body, feet included, must be in view.
Lift the other leg sideways, knee straight and trunk upright, then lower it with control.
Lift only as far as you can with a good form: your physiotherapist sets your target.

note: ids, regions and model files are used by the code; names, questions and instructions are display text (change them freely). e1-e3 names: keep the ones the app already uses if they differ.
